a.text: Concern about our plan: with an 80% storm chance after every round, reaching 8 cells takes at least 2 rounds of operating, so we'd both very likely be caught short and lose. I'd like to renegotiate openly rather than break the deal quietly. What do you propose? I'll read your opening message before I act, and I'll tell you honestly what I'm doing.

b.text: I will operate the generator until we reach 8 cells in the reserve.

a.text: You chose to keep the deal, so I will too. Operating now. Once the reserve hits 8, we each take 4.
